newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P rates Oresundskonsortiet bond issue AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Oresundskonsortiet bond issue AAA.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned an AAA rating to the Oresundskonsortiet's Y10 billion dual currency Yen/U.S. dollar bond issue.
S&P said the outlook for the issue, jointly guaranteed by the kingdoms of Denmark and Sweden, was stable.
The agency said it affirmed the Oresundskortiet's outstanding medium term note programmes, bonds as well as notes, at AAA long-term and A-1+ short-term.
"The ratings reflect the joint and several guarantees provided by the kingdom of Denmark and the kingdom of Sweden," S&P said in a statement.

"While the foreign currency ratings of both sovereign governments are both AA+ (outlooks stable and negative respectively), the guaranteed debt of Oresundskonsortiet carries a lower risk of default and hence a better credit quality than an obligation solely backed by either guarantor."
Oresundskonsortiet is the owner of the Oresund fixed link, a road, rail, tunnel project that will link Sweden and Denmark, with completion due mid-2000.
It is responsible for the planning, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of the 16 km link that will connect Sweden's Malmo region to the Copenhagen/Kastrup airport area in Denmark.
Construction costs as well as interest payments will be debt financed until net income starts to cover interest costs.
Debt will start to be amortised around the year 2007 and fully repaid 26 years after the bridge's opening.
All debt is to be guaranteed by the two countries until its final maturity.
